name: Thai Sikh Run (31st ed.)
short_description: The Thai Sikh Run is a half-marathon (with a 10km option) held in Bangkok's Old Siam Plaza area on January 31, 2027.
ai_summary: The Thai Sikh Run is a half-marathon event scheduled for January 31, 2027, in Bangkok, Thailand, organized by the Thai Sikh community organizing committee. Now in its 31st edition, the race takes place around the Old Siam Plaza area and offers two distances: a 21.1km half-marathon and a 10km option. Registration details have not yet been announced.

faqs.question: When is the Thai Sikh Run taking place?
faqs.answer: The Thai Sikh Run is scheduled to take place on January 31, 2027. This edition marks the 31st running of the event, which is held in Bangkok, Thailand, around the Old Siam Plaza area, according to the available details.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Thai Sikh Run?
faqs.answer: The Thai Sikh Run offers two distance options for participants: a 21.1km half-marathon, which serves as the primary distance, and a shorter 10km course. Both distances are part of the same event held in Bangkok's Old Siam Plaza area.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Thai Sikh Run?
faqs.answer: The Thai Sikh Run is organized by the Thai Sikh community organizing committee. This committee has overseen the event through 31 editions, with the race taking place in the Old Siam Plaza area of Bangkok, Thailand.
